Task: Execute Frontend & Motion Overhaul Phase
Mode: Orchestrator (or Architect)

Context:
In the previous phase, we stabilized the Kirby CMS backend, locked down our media handling, and implemented the foundational CSS base for our fluid.glass aesthetic. We are now ready to heavily overhaul the frontend layout engine and implement our motion layer.

Core Objectives:

Deep Dive into Fluid.glass Architecture: Thoroughly analyze https://fluid.glass/approach and https://fluid.glass/projects. We need to replicate their high-end, brutalist structural patterns.
Refine the Bento Grid: The current Bento Grid snippet needs to be re-engineered. Looking closely at fluid.glass, their grid components are much more uniform, utilize extremely precise gaps, and feel like a perfectly mathematically structured canvas. Refactor site/snippets/blocks/bento-grid.php to match this exact uniformity and gap precision.
Advanced Structural Layouts: Implement sticky asymmetric columns (where a left-hand typography column stays pinned while the right-hand media column scrolls freely, as seen on their /approach page).
Horizontal Scroll Sections: Implement a horizontal scroll carousel mapping to vertical scroll (as seen on their /projects page).
Motion Layer Integration: Prepare the DOM for and begin implementing GSAP scroll-triggers and Lenis smooth scrolling to create the tension between static brutalism and fluid interaction.
Please start by drafting an updated blueprint/schema for how our Bento Grid CSS and layout builder logic needs to change to achieve the fluid.glass level of precision.
